user.title: Connect to pi (va-bridge)
user.description: In pi on the machine where it lives, run /va-bridge setup and /va-bridge start, then enter the address and token it shows.

data_description.api_token: The PI_BRIDGE_TOKEN the bridge was started with

reauth_confirm.title: New bridge token
reauth_confirm.description: The pi bridge at {url} rejected the token.

data.detach_message: Message when a task continues in the background
data.busy_message: Message when pi is still busy

data_description.prompt: Added to pi's system prompt (templates allowed). pi's own AGENTS.md, skills and extensions are always used.
data_description.reply_budget: If pi is still working after this long, it says the background message and announces the answer on the same voice device when done.
data_description.reset_hours: Only for one session per device: how long it must be quiet before pi starts a new session.
